items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I didn’t know Hal that well

ctx.x: Did you decide who was going to be in the section? Because it’s Hal McKusick, Warne, Ted Brown, and Jimmy Giuffre. Were those your choices?
I would think Warne and Ted would’ve been. I didn’t know Hal that well but its possible. I would say Hal was probably suggested by Jimmy. I had nothing to say about the rhythm section I remember.
The rhythm section, by the way, is Bill Evans, Buddy Clark, and the now legendary Ronnie Free.
